{{Top|leg}}
The '''High Flight Squadron crest''' was the insignia of [[High Flight Squadron]], a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] unit. The patch showed a single [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] soaring high above a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] peak.<ref name="soa">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>
